title: Final Countdown: 12:00 PM Approaching

fields.headline: Threat Window: 12:00 PM Imminent
fields.narration: The clock on the wall ticks toward noon. The AODB server logs show a final heartbeat at 11:44:58 — a routine health check. The scheduled task 'AODB_IndexMaintenance' is now active. It will execute in 62 seconds. The system is in final countdown mode. All eyes are on the IT console. The threat is real. The window to act is closing.
keyFacts: Scheduled task 'AODB_IndexMaintenance' is now active and will run in 62 seconds.
AODB database and FIDS data feed are at risk of corruption and deletion.
The ransom note 'You should have hired me. — D' will be deployed if the task completes.
The AODB server's service account 'svc_nexgen_aodb' is still active and authorized to execute.
No further action can be taken from the IT console once the task begins.
fields.expectedAction: If the scheduled task has not been deleted, the team must immediately activate the emergency backup (A-18) and notify all teams that the AODB system will be unavailable for 1–2 hours. Contingency: manually override FIDS and use paper manifests.
fields.scenarioTitle: Scenario 8: Anonymous Threat, Logic Bomb Hunt

instructorNote: This inject closes the final decision window. The threat is now active. If players haven't deleted the scheduled task, they must accept that the logic bomb will detonate at 12:00 PM.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Emergency Plan (AEP)
citations.headingPath: AEP › Part II › Appendix 5 › 5.1 Power Grid Failure
citations.quote: Generators 1 and 2 auto-start within 15 seconds. If auto-start fails, Maintenance manually transfers load at the Airfield Lighting Vault. If runway edge lights cannot be restored, the runway is CLOSED

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: - LEO/Security: assume IC; threat assessment; decide evacuate/search/heighten awareness; notify FBI, TSA, request Bomb Squad; if device found, perimeter and evacuate. - Ops: await LEO IC; PA announcem

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.headingPath: TIRP › Section 12 › 12.2 Guiding Principle: RUN. HIDE. FIGHT.
citations.quote: RUN if a clear path exists. HIDE: lock/barricade, lights off, phones silent. FIGHT as an absolute last resort.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: - All Staff: RUN. HIDE. FIGHT.; call 911 or ACC with shooter location/description when safe. - LEO/Security: assume IC; contact teams; establish cold/warm/hot zones; declare scene secure for EMS. - Op
